notes.title: Patch 10
notes.notes:
What's New?

-Level 2 is more or less complete, sans some cosmetic things. Still need to work on Level 1.
-New Puzzles in Level 2.
-Added a "Quit Game" button to the Main Menu
-Erasing Save Data actually does what it's supposed to now, and Lives = 4 on restart instead of 0.
-Added the "Extra Life" collectible.

What's Fixed?

-Fixed a bug in Level 1 that wouldn't spawn a platform if you hit the switch that did so, left the level, and came back in.
-Ancient Coins, Coins, and Extra Lives you pick up stay picked up.

-----

The Demo ends when you collect all currently collectible Ancient Coins (11), and then return to the Overworld/Hub.

As always, I appreciate everyone for their interest in Secrets of the Temple! Please leave any bugs/glitches/problems you find in the Discussions on Steam, and Enjoy Patch number 10!

-Pigmy

notes.title: A Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello all!

I just wanted to post an announcement to bring everyone up to speed on how Secrets of the Temple's development is going.

It's going quite well!

A few weeks ago, my PC suffered a catastrophic failure where one of my RAM sticks decided to short out the slot it was in and this caused memory issues, which in turn caused problems with Windows, and the PC became unresponsive. 

I lost everything. Secrets of the Temple's Raw Files included. Devastation ensued.

I took the PC to BestBuy, Geek Squad fixed it good as new, and we're back in action! The only downside is I had to start Secrets of the Temple from scratch. It gave me the opportunity to really take a look at the direction the game was going, and I have to say it was burning me out. Starting over may have been the best thing for me. 

Currently, on the beta branch*, I have a playable build of the "reimagined" Secrets of the Temple, and I plan to continue polishing it and adding to it as the weeks go on. This will allow me to create the best possible game for everyone to enjoy. I have to say I love the direction its taken, and I can't wait to show everyone the end result. The current regular branch is the "old" Secrets of the Temple that will soon be gone, once I feel comfortable with what I have.

We're gonna stay in Early Access for a little while longer than expected. But hopefully you'll see the new build, with all new mechanics, within the next month!

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. 

-Pigmy

*Beta Branch is not publicly available

notes.title: Steam Build Version 2
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

Thank you all for playing Secrets of the Temple this past month! As my earlier post has said, my wedding is in 7 days! :O!!! CRAZY! I promised that I would work on this game after the wedding, and this is still true! I wanted to release a newer build for y'all before things got too too crazy. So, without further ado, Here it is!!


THE STEAM BUILD - VERSION 2
What's changed?

-Implemented a Pause Menu! 

----Escape will no longer automatically bring you back to the main menu of the game. Now you have options! You can save and reload, you can change your graphics settings (A lot of you were asking for this), and you can straight up quit the whole game right from the pause screen.

-Implemented a new obstacle: THE VINES

----Vines now block your way at certain points of the temple rendering passage impossible! Find the dagger hiding in the level somewhere to cut down those pesky plants!


That's it for this build! I said Level 4 would be ready too, but I'm still working on it for now. Enjoy these changes though! And let me know if you find any more bugs!!

Thanks again for playing Secrets of the Temple, I appreciate all of the feedback!

-Pigmy

notes.title: The Sloan Build - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
First off, Thank you to everyone who has downloaded and played Secrets of the Temple thus far! I cannot tell you how much I appreciate you all! Special thanks to my Beta Testers and those that have given reviews of it! You all are the reason I want to become a Professional Developer!

Now, Onwards to content!

I would like to clear up a few things in the current build:

There are 3 completely playable levels in the game. Each one more difficult than the last. 

Yes. Pressing ESC does boot you back to the menu, BUT, pressing LOAD from the menu will start you fresh in the last level you were in! The only way to erase that is to close the game completely. 

Those are really the biggest changes! I'm working on Level 4, and a partial layout will be out in the next update, so stay tuned! and Thanks again for playing!


-Pigmy
